answer.reason: Two events of the story belong to Nob: David's visit to the priest Ahimelech, and the killing of its people by Saul's order.

clauses.english: was where David came to the priest Ahimelech and asked for bread
clauses.quote: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest

clauses.english: was put to the sword, men, women and children, by Doeg at Saul's command
clauses.quote: Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword

doubts: 1SA 21:16 (2SA 21:16) is marked but names Ishbibenob, a different person whose name only resembles Nob, so it was left out.
NEH 11:32 and ISA 10:32 only list Nob among settlements and say it is near Jerusalem, so they were not used.
